name: Fixture Internal Platform
description: Makes the baseline Platform concern specific to an internal developer platform, without narrowing what it covers.

alphas.name: Platform
alphas.description: The shared technical foundation on which the organisation's services run.

states.name: Identified
states.description: The need for a shared foundation is understood and agreed.

checklist.name: Self-service need recorded
checklist.description: The developer-facing capabilities the platform must offer are written down.

states.name: Available
states.description: The foundation exists and teams can use it.

checklist.name: Golden path exists
checklist.description: At least one documented path takes a team from empty repository to running service.

states.name: Operating
states.description: The foundation runs production workloads and is observed.

checklist.name: Adoption measured
checklist.description: How many teams use the golden path is measured rather than assumed.
